name: Sermorelin
effects: First 29 amino acids of GHRH — directly stimulates pituitary GH secretion
Previously FDA-approved for pediatric GH deficiency (Geref); discontinued 2008 (commercial reasons)
Now compounded off-label for adult anti-aging / GH optimization
Short half-life ~10–20 min; stimulates physiological GH pulsatility
Increases IGF-1; improves body composition and sleep quality over months
Better side-effect profile than exogenous GH — cannot cause acromegaly
Flushing, headache, transient injection site reactions common
